title: An early exit landing after the cycle ends pays the top penalty
rootCause: Lock.earlyExitById takes its penalty from the time left in the cycle when it is mined, and accepts no limit from the caller, so an exit sent as a cycle ends and mined just after it pays close to the highest penalty.

poc.observable: test_an_early_exit_landing_late_pays_what_it_saw fails with "the penalty paid, against the one seen: 49999000000000000000 > 15000000000000000000"
